title: Grateful Dead Live at Straight Theater, Haight Street on 1967-07-23
lineage: recording released as a flexi-disc in the 1st printing of The Dead Book

ai_review.summary: Incomplete soundboard fragment that includes the earliest Lovelight excerpt and a lengthy Neal Cassady rap.
ai_review.review: The three reviews agree that this file is far from a full concert – it’s an ~8‑minute soundboard snippet that mostly captures Neal Cassady’s rambling spoken piece, with only a brief early version of “Lovelight” as music. While the historical novelty (Cassady rap, early Lovelight) earns it some interest and 4‑star marks from reviewers, the missing bulk of the performance makes it a poor representation of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers rate it 4 stars for its rarity but repeatedly note that the recording is severely incomplete, limiting musical enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: File is only ~8 minutes long, missing most of the concert. Contains early Lovelight fragment and a spoken Cassady rap; overall incomplete and not representative of full show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not applicable – the recording is an excerpt focused on spoken content rather than a coherent set.
